information.title: Information
information.emailHint: If you change it, you will have to confirm the new address before going on.

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.description: Your groups, their words, your collections and your favorites will be permanently deleted. The words you added to other people’s groups will stay there, without your username.
deletion.confirmMessage: Everything you created will be deleted and the people you shared it with will no longer have access to it. This cannot be undone.
deletion.failed: Your account could not be deleted. Try again.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.failed: Your preferences could not be saved. Try again.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: The language of the menus, buttons and emails. It does not change the language of the words.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The system theme follows your device’s setting.

style.title: Style
style.description: How the interface looks. It combines with the light or dark theme.

sober.label: Sober
sober.description: Clean and understated, in neutral colours.

colorful.label: Colourful
colorful.description: Rounded font, vivid colours and sticker-like cards.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Choose which emails you receive. The ones about your account (address confirmation, forgotten password) are always sent.
emails.word_group_access_requested: Someone asks for access to one of your groups, or to contribute to it
emails.group_collection_access_requested: Someone asks for access to one of your collections, or to contribute to it
emails.access_request_decided: One of your requests is accepted or refused
emails.share_type_changed: Your type of sharing of a group or collection changes
emails.word_group_favorited: Someone adds one of your groups to their favorites
emails.group_collection_favorited: Someone adds one of your collections to their favorites
